title: Introduce IPAM-driven subnet allocator and tenant VPC segmentation
author: Nikhil Rao
description: Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in multi-tenant on-prem/VPC environments requested deterministic, auditable subnet allocation and simpler cross-account peering wiring. This PR adds an IPAM-driven subnet allocator into the installer pipeline and splits control-plane VPCs by tenant groups to reduce blast radius and make route/security policies explicit. High level changes: 1) Terraform module 'redwood_ipam_allocator' that consumes AWS VPC IPAM pools (or a local IPAM JSON for air-gapped installs) and produces a predictable /24 allocation per tenant with tags for lifecycle; 2) Installer orchestration changes to optionally create tenant-scoped control-plane VPCs (config flag tenant_segmentation = true) and wire conditional peering attachments with tag-based auto-acceptance hooks for partner accounts; 3) Security group templating to create lease-scoped SGs that are parameterized by tenant ID and environment (dev/stage/prod); 4) Route53 private hosted zone delegation automation that creates delegated zones per-tenant when cross-account peering is enabled and annotates them for later teardown; 5) Helm chart values to expose allocator metrics and health-check endpoints for the allocator controller, plus RBAC entries needed for on-prem installer mode. Rollout & migration notes: The default behavior is opt-in (tenant_segmentation=false). For existing single-VPC installs, the PR includes a migration plan that 1) creates an IPAM import snapshot, 2) simulates allocations in dry-run mode and 3) exposes a guided terraform apply that creates tenant VPCs and migrates subnets with minimal downtime. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module and tests - [x] Installer orchestration changes and dry-run mode - [x] Helm chart changes and e2e smoke test - [x] Route53 delegation with rollback path - [x] Docs and upgrade guide added Context: this avoids ad-hoc CIDR calculations, reduces human error during large multi-tenant rollouts, and gives SRE teams an auditable allocation log. See linked linear tasks for follow-ups (cleanup automation, IPAM reconciliation runner, telemetry dashboards).

review_comments: Aisha: Can we add a safety validation to reject overlapping allocations from external IPAMs? Author: added overlap check + unit test.
Diego: Need a rollback path if Route53 delegation fails during migration. Author: documented delegation teardown and added idempotent delegation step.
Priya: Helm chart RBAC looks broad for on-prem mode. Author: narrowed roles and added a feature flag helm.values.allocator.rbac_enabled.
Kenny (ops): Suggest adding metrics: allocations_total and allocation_errors. Author: added Prometheus metrics and dashboard placeholder.
release_notes: Opt-in IPAM-driven subnet allocator + tenant-scoped control-plane VPCs. Adds Terraform module for IPAM imports, installer dry-run & migration guide, Helm changes to expose allocator health and RBAC. No breaking changes when tenant_segmentation=false.
notes_for_ops: When enabling tenant_segmentation: ensure IPAM pool has adequate free prefixes, run dry-run allocations in staging, and validate route53 delegation with account owner before production cutover. Watch allocator metrics (allocations_total, allocation_errors, allocation_latency_ms).
security_impact: Minor: new IAM roles for allocator controller in on-prem mode. Scoped to ipam:Get/Allocate and route53:AssociateVpcWithHostedZone when delegation is enabled. Docs include least-privilege templates.
testing_summary: Unit tests for allocator logic, integration tests that run terraform plan against a mock IPAM JSON, e2e smoke test for helm chart deployment on kind cluster for the allocator controller, and a migration dry-run validated against staging environment.
upgrade_instructions: 1) Set tenant_segmentation=false (default) and apply to get allocator module installed in dry-run mode. 2) Run terraform apply with dry_run=true to see simulated allocations. 3) After verification, set tenant_segmentation=true and follow migration guide in installer/migrations/migrate-single-to-segmented.md. 4) Validate DNS delegation and peering in staging before prod.
